templates.name: recarga_concluida
templates.description: The pull completed after the 24-hour window shut (a run left it to `npm run poll`). {{1}} is the amount, {{2}} the Pix end-to-end id.
templates.body: Oi! A recarga de {{1}} caiu na sua conta. Comprovante do Pix (end-to-end): {{2}}

templates.name: recarga_concluida
templates.description: The English copy of recarga_concluida. Same variables.
templates.body: Hi! The top-up of {{1}} is in your account. Pix receipt (end-to-end): {{2}}

templates.name: recarga_link_expirado
templates.description: The bank's consent link expired unapproved, told outside the 24-hour window. Nothing was pulled. {{1}} is the amount.
templates.body: Oi! O link do banco para a recarga de {{1}} expirou antes da aprovação. Nada foi puxado.

buttons.title: Mandar outro
buttons.intent: quero que voce mande outro link para a mesma recarga

templates.name: recarga_link_expirado
templates.description: The English copy of recarga_link_expirado. Same variables and the same buttons.
templates.body: Hi! The bank's link for the top-up of {{1}} expired before it was approved. Nothing was pulled.

buttons.title: Send another
buttons.intent: I want you to send another link for the same top-up

buttons.title: Not now
buttons.intent: not now, I do not want another top-up

templates.name: recarga_atualizacao
templates.description: The FALLBACK: sent by a poll, outside the 24-hour window, for an outcome with no template of its own (a pull the bank declined, a request denied). It states NOTHING about the outcome, so it can never be the wrong news; an answer reopens the window. Takes no variables.
templates.body: Oi! Temos uma atualização sobre a sua recarga. Responda esta mensagem para continuarmos por aqui.

buttons.title: Falar agora
buttons.intent: quero saber qual e a atualizacao da minha recarga

templates.name: recarga_atualizacao
templates.description: The English copy of recarga_atualizacao. Same buttons.
templates.body: Hi! There is an update on your top-up. Reply to this message to continue here.

buttons.title: Talk now
buttons.intent: I want to know what the update on my top-up is
